description: A FULL RESET CMD from the peer resets this node's ARQ machine: its partly sent C_PDU is rejected, a partly received C_PDU is flushed, a C_PDU not yet started stays queued; the FULL RESET ACK goes first and the queued C_PDU follows it from FSN 0.
note: Link setup and first DATA-ONLY as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip (Caller), with dts.ack_wait_ms 600000 so the wait does not expire here: FSN 0 with 'ping' goes at 108000. At 126000 the peer sends a DATA-ONLY with FSN 0, C_PDU START but not END, TX WIN UWE and LWE set, 'half': the first segment of a C_PDU, held (RX LWE 1), owing an acknowledgement. The ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 goes at 181000. At 188500, during the peer's next burst, the client sends 'pong', queued as ARQ (its TTD is later, so dts.ttd stays). At 189000 the peer's FULL RESET CMD (FULL RESET CMD 1, RESET FRAME ID 5, NEW RECEIVE LWE 0). It is new (no RESET FRAME ID received yet on this connection, C-0271, C-1173), so this node acts (C-0811): window edges to the initial values (C-0812); 'ping', partly completed, is discarded from the transmit queue and rejected to the CAS (C-0813, C-0826, C-1176), so dts.ack_wait stops and dts.ttd moves to the TTD of 'pong' (188500 + 1296000000); the receive buffers are flushed (C-0814), so the 'half' segment is gone; DATA(CONNECTED) goes to IDLE(CONNECTED) (C-0681) and, with 'pong' still queued, to DATA(CONNECTED) (C-1176). The reply is a FULL RESET ACK: RESET ACK 1, NEW RECEIVE LWE 0, RESET FRAME ID 0, the other flags 0 (C-0815 to C-0819). At 230000 (contention 36000) one transmission carries the FULL RESET ACK first (C-1174) and then 'pong' as a DATA-ONLY with FSN 0 from the reset window (C-0826), TX WIN UWE and LWE set: 15 + 29 bytes, 2 blocks, both EOT 20. dts.ack_wait starts at 240350. At 244000 the peer, now reset, sends an ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 and then a DATA-ONLY with FSN 0, START and END, 'new!'. The ACK-ONLY is processed in DATA(CONNECTED) (no WARNING, C-0659 does not apply) and confirms 'pong': dts.ack_wait and dts.ttd stop. FSN 0 is new to the flushed receive window, so 'new!' is delivered (had the 'half' segment been kept, FSN 0 would be a copy). The ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 goes at 287000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): the DATA-ONLY transmission at 108000 (29 bytes) leaves 21 bytes of its last block, filled with one PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes) to 0.0.1.3, recorded Ed4 (C-0367, C-0887), and 10 bytes are zero filled; every other transmission leaves too few bytes for an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU, or none, so it is zero filled.
